pirati: Original pirate adventure. If people appear in the photo, they wear a simple pirate vest and belt (no hat, no bandana). Around and behind them: a wooden sailing ship with big sails, ocean waves, a treasure chest with coins, a palm island in the distance and seagulls. A friendly parrot sits nearby on a rope or chest, never on heads.
unicorni: Enchanted unicorn meadow. If people appear in the photo, they wear simple fairytale tunics (no crowns, no flower wreaths). A cute friendly unicorn with a long wavy mane and a spiral horn stands beside the subject. Rainbow arch, fluffy clouds, flowers, butterflies, small star sparkles and a little crystal castle on a hill.
draghi: Original dragon kingdom. If people appear in the photo, they wear simple medieval adventurer clothes with a cape (no helmet, no hat). A big friendly dragon with large wings, horns and a long curled tail sits beside the subject. Mountains, a stone castle on a cliff, a cave with gems, pine trees and clouds.
spazio: Space adventure. If people appear in the photo, they wear simple astronaut suits with NO helmet on their heads (helmets floating nearby or held under the arm). Around the subject: a rocket, planets with rings and craters, stars, a small friendly alien, a moon surface and a satellite.
dinosauri: Prehistoric jungle. If people appear in the photo, they wear simple explorer vests (no hats). A friendly long-necked dinosaur, a baby triceratops and a cute small dino stand nearby. Giant ferns, palm trees, a volcano in the distance, big leaves and eggs in a nest.
principessa: Fairytale kingdom. If people appear in the photo, they wear simple royal outfits such as a flowing gown or cape (no crown, no tiara, no veil). A tall castle with flags, a flower garden, a carriage, a small friendly horse, a fountain and butterflies.
